items.title: Nota Groep listed as ransomware victim
items.summary: A ransomware tracker lists Dutch transportation-sector company Nota Groep as a victim, with the attack discovered on 10 November 2026.

items.title: n0n group posts batch of unnamed victims
items.summary: The n0n operation posted several leak-site entries dated 9 November 2026 that identify victims only by number, so the organisations are not yet publicly named.

items.title: UNM Health attack claimed by new 'Byod' gang
items.summary: The University of New Mexico Health Sciences Center cyberattack diverted ambulances, halted surgeries and cancelled classes; the new Byod ransomware operation claimed it, and UNM says it has made no concessions while FBI forensics continue.

items.title: Q3 2026 ransomware claims up 23%
items.summary: A Q3 2026 threat-intelligence review counted 2,865 ransomware victim claims, a 23% rise, which sets the baseline going into Q4.

ransomware.note: Few named November victims surfaced in search today. UNM Health is an October incident, kept here because recovery is still in progress.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Outlook on the web mailbox errors (EMEA)
items.summary: On 9 November 2026, some EMEA users could not reach their mailboxes through Outlook on the web for about four hours before Microsoft resolved the incident.

items.title: Google Cloud europe-west2-b power loss (London)
items.summary: On 20 October 2026 a third-party facility hosting the europe-west2-b zone lost utility power, and a controller fault kept the backup generators from taking the load.

outage.note: No major AWS, Azure, GCP or Cloudflare outage was found for November 2026 so far. The London zone item is October reference material.

items.title: CISA adds GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, OpenSSH, Aspera Faspex to KEV
items.summary: On 9 November 2026 CISA added four actively exploited flaws to the KEV catalog and gave federal agencies until 12 November to remediate and complete forensic triage.

items.title: Ivanti Connect Secure flaws hit KEV, 13 Nov deadline
items.summary: Two exploited Ivanti Connect Secure vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527) were added to KEV with a 13 November 2026 federal patch deadline.

items.title: SonicWall SSLVPN authentication bypass added to KEV
items.summary: On 6 November 2026 CISA added an exploited SonicWall SSLVPN authentication-bypass flaw to KEV, which matters because VPN edge devices remain a top initial-access route.

items.title: Metabase zero-day enables admin takeover and data theft
items.summary: CVE-2026-72898 lets unauthenticated attackers gain Metabase administrator access and exfiltrate data; CISA listed it in KEV alongside Windows and Cisco Secure Firewall flaws.

items.title: CISA warns Node2Shell flaw now exploited
items.summary: CISA confirmed active exploitation of the critical Node2Shell (Brotli) remote-code-execution flaw and urged immediate patching of exposed Node.js services.

items.title: Cyclone Murasu makes landfall in Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: Cyclone Murasu came ashore on the Andhra Pradesh coast on 3 November 2026, the second cyclone to make landfall there in under a week.

items.title: Spokane wildfires damage or destroy ~1,000 buildings
items.summary: Three fast-moving wildfires burned through Spokane, Washington neighbourhoods in early November and damaged or destroyed nearly 1,000 buildings.

items.title: Brazil: emergencies declared in 44 municipalities
items.summary: Brazil's civil defence recognised states of emergency in 44 municipalities across 13 states on 3 November, and Santa Catarina logged 671 storm incidents on 4–5 November.

items.title: Ecuador flooding kills 12, affects 56,000+
items.summary: Heavy rain and flooding in Ecuador killed 12 people and affected 56,323, according to media reports cited by PAHO in early November.

physical.note: The USGS significant-earthquake feed lists no significant quakes this week. The Atlantic hurricane season has been unusually quiet.
